summary: Completed i18n testing for BidVex bilingual auction platform. All requested features are working correctly: legal pages (Terms of Service and Privacy Policy) dynamically render EN or FR content based on language selection, language switching works across all pages, and language preference persists across page navigation and reloads via localStorage.

issues: Cookie consent modal appears in English regardless of language setting - consider translating this modal

critical_code_review_comments: Note: The actual routes are /terms-of-service and /privacy-policy, NOT /terms and /privacy as mentioned in the review request. The implementation is correct, just the route names differ from what was expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n implementation is complete and working. Legal pages use separate component files (TermsEN/TermsFR and PrivacyEN/PrivacyFR) that are conditionally rendered based on i18n.language. Language persistence works via localStorage with key 'bidvex_language'. Site is in 'coming_soon' mode - use ?preview_mode=true parameter to access the main app.
